name: Progressive Encoding of Time-Varying Sequences
aliases: I-frame and P-frame encoding for volume data
definition: A scheme for encoding time-varying volumetric data where frames are encoded individually but reuse codebooks from previous frames to improve performance and compression.
summary: Progressive Encoding of Time-Varying Sequences compresses volumetric data by reusing codebooks from previous frames to improve performance, distinguishing itself from static vector quantization through temporal dependencies.
